win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD ROCKET
wilds.behavior:
When the special Wild Rocket symbol lands it reveals a multiplier: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x and 20x. The multiplier is then multiplied by the number of grid positions covered while expanding to the top of the grid.

 All expanded Wild Rocket positions count as WILD symbols and substitute for all paying symbols.

 When multiple expanding wild rocket reels participate in the same win line their multipliers are added together.

wilds.name: CHOCOLATE BLAST Bonus
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the CHOCOLATE BLAST bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 During this bonus game there is an increased chance of landing Wild Rocket symbols!

 BONUS scatter symbols are not available during the bonus game.

wilds.name: WILD ROCKET FESTIVAL Bonus
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the WILD ROCKET FESTIVAL bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 During this bonus game there is an increased chance of landing Wild Rocket symbols! Wild Rocket symbols remain sticky for the duration of the bonus game and reveal a new initial multiplier on each spin.

 If a new Wild Rocket symbol lands below an existing one, it replaces it.

 BONUS scatter symbols are not available during the bonus game.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Enter a world of chocolate and sweetness! Chocolate Rocket is a 5-reel, 5-row game with paylines with a distinctive expand functionality. When the Wild Rocket symbol lands it reveals a multiplier and flies up to the top of the grid, multiplying its multiplier by the number of grid positions covered.

 The maximum win in this game is 12,500 times your bet, and can be achieved in all game modes.
